name: @khorsheed/dsh-eval
description: The web-eval orchestrator: dataseek contract schemas, plan/condition validation, deterministic hashing, run-template generation from a suite manifest, the stage-one/two run loop (per-cell materialization, byte-exact delegation, submit/transition, archive gate, bundle export), and the bundle report (results.jsonl + summary.md behind the four-invariant gate)

compat.notes: injects commands (the /eval slash face); the run verb probes datasets / mission / localAgent via ctx.get and refuses naming any missing one — never a boot failure; report only reads bundles and consumes no host capability; the delegation cwd option and the usage / model.observed read-back (settled event, else delegationOf) are consumed from the local-agent family (T11) — against a facade predating it the cwd option is ignored (the cell is then refused honestly, never mis-attributed) and the read-back is recorded as null; the three read tools (eval_conditions / eval_plan_validate / eval_run_status) join through deferred injection on `tools`, and their prompt section through `systemPrompt` — a composition mounting neither registry keeps the slash, CLI, and service faces and boots fine
